title: Bug - Forward application arguments through WCode test lifecycle
createdBy: codex during the SwiftUUI Museum executable parity audit
description: WCode test mode forwarded the command tail to its test driver but launched the retained application with an empty argument list, preventing realistic command-line and Windows App SDK protocol-activation tests.
acceptanceCriteria: WCode test mode launches the retained application with the parsed core forwarded arguments.
The existing test driver continues receiving the same forwarded arguments for compatibility.
Parser coverage proves an opaque ----ms-protocol argument survives the authority grammar exactly.
A native retained-app journey proves Windows protocol activation reaches SwiftUUI onOpenURL.
implementationInstructions: Pass coreForwardedArguments() into RetainedProcessRequest when operation is WCode application test.
Do not reparse, normalize, or strip opaque application arguments after the Vaporize authority token is resolved.
Keep the current shared application-and-driver command tail compatible until a separately typed driver-argument channel is introduced.
Verify the parser in VaporizeCUJ01SwiftPMCLITests, then run the real app and driver through Vaporize test wcode with the protocol argument.
notes: The focused parser test passed. SwiftUUI Museum subsequently launched through WCode with ----ms-protocol:swiftuui-museum://open/behavior and rendered the received URL through the native AppInstance activation path.
